name: Tidalwave of Raw Power
body:
Prerequisite(s): Heir to Power Unstable, Incredible Hidden Power

Benefit(s): While in your social identity, you can accept one point of burn as a free action to increase the speed of your transformation between identities by one step (ignoring your normal inability to accept burn while in your social identity). When you accept burn in this way, you calculate your combat maneuver bonus for all effects related to Heir to Power Unstable as if your Constitution modifier was double its normal value until the end of your round.

When you reach 13th level, you automatically lose this feat and gain the Mask of Raw Divinity feat in its place.
